LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Trail_Text: {PAWN} found single silver coins lying in a line from the store {WAY}, a few steps apart, {COUNT} of them. The last of them are gone.
LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Way_Door: out through the door and on toward the edge of the land
LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Way_Open: on toward the edge of the land
LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Saw_Trail: {WHO} found {COUNT} coins lying in a line from the store at {HOME} out toward the edge of the land, as if the silver had walked off.
LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Purse_Text: {PAWN} pressed {COUNT} silver into {VISITOR}'s hand and wouldn't take it back. {PEOPLE} think the better of {HOME} for it.
LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Book_Purse: {PAWN} pressed coins into the hand of {VISITOR}, a stranger at our gate, and would not take them back.
LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Beetle_Text: A golden beetle walked across the table and down onto the floor, and {PAWN}, following it, found a gold coin where it stopped. Nobody dropped it.
LanguageData.CC_GodDucat_Saw_Beetle: {WHO} followed a golden beetle across the floor at {HOME} and found a gold coin where it stopped.
